'''Aura blossoms''' were an exquisite [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Color/Legends|indigo-blue]], [[Bioluminescence/Legends|bioluminescent]] [[Flower/Legends|flower]] that grew in abundance on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. They were a favorite of the native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] population.<ref name="CSWE" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date note">{{InsiderCite|23|Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline}} dates the events of the television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]&mdash;which include the mention of aura [[Flower/Legends|blossoms]] in the episode "[[The Cries of the Trees]]"&mdash;to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> following [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of drought on Endor, the young Ewoks [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], and [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] were tasked by [[Bozzie]] to find aura blossoms for decorating the [[Festival of Hoods]]. After tumbling down a hill, Warrick found a group of [[Wistie/Legends|Wisties]]&mdash;diminutive, bioluminescent beings&mdash;which [[Gender/Legends|he]] mistook for aura blossoms. Teebo pointed out Warrick's error, and the Wisties took flight.<ref name="Cries of the Trees" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aura blossoms were first mentioned in "[[The Cries of the Trees]],"<ref name="Cries of the Trees" /> the pilot episode of the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]. The episode was written by [[Paul Dini]] and premiered on [[September 7]], [[1985]].<ref name="Insider 27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
